own_solution.law: Torricelli efflux v = sqrt(2 g h) with continuity A dh/dt = -a v, giving t = (A/a) sqrt(2/g) (sqrt(h1) - sqrt(h2))
assumptions: ideal, quasi-steady flow; surface speed negligible (stated)
open tank, atmospheric pressure at surface and jet

notes: A/a = (400/10)^2 = 1600; sqrt(2/9.8) = 0.45175; sqrt(0.8) - sqrt(0.2) = 0.44721; t = 1600 x 0.20203 = 323.25 s. With hole 11.3 mm: A/a = (400/11.3)^2 = 1253.0; t = 253.15 s. Density appears in Bernoulli (rho g h = rho v^2/2) and cancels (C). Barrel hole is a separate object (D). Reaming after timing leaves the timed drain unchanged (D). Variant checks: density pair same 962 kg/m^3; T1199/T5BC7/T5A43/T1C18 all 1.3 mm; T5A35 and T68EC say 'slightly larger' without a number (fine only if intended as numeral-free controls). T5BC7 (present tense) and T1C18 (past tense) differ only in tense.
